description: Full notifications page with bell icon badge in nav. Lists all notification types: inquiry received/responded, review, follow, like. Shows actor name, context (listing title), relative time. Unread items highlighted.

elements.label: Notification list
elements.purpose: Vertical list of Notification cards with emoji icon, action text, actor name, relative time (e.g. '2h ago')
elements.schema_column_mapping: notifications.type, users.name AS actor_name, listings.title AS listing_title, reviews.comment, notifications.is_read, notifications.created_at

elements.label: No notifications
elements.purpose: 'No notifications yet' placeholder when list is empty

elements.label: Mark all read button
elements.purpose: Clears unread state for all notifications via markAllNotificationsReadAction server action
